notes.title: V2.0 FREE update, Out now!
notes.notes:
Ten Bells has been out a month and we can't thank you all enough for checking out the game, wish-listing, reviewing and streaming our game. The reception has been overwhelming and we couldn't have hoped for a better roll out so far. 
[h1]
[b]However, we're not done. [/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/4a30d5bdb3f5da9246806f861d4cfee283ee67b4.png[/img]

As we hinted over on our [url=https://discord.gg/vkQEhWAnz2]discord channel[/url], we've got an update for you. Introducing [b]Ten Bells v.2.0[/b], a [u]FREE UPDATE[/u] to those of you wanting a more challenging experience during the spooky season! This update includes:

[list]
[*] A new hard "NIGHTMARE" mode
[*] A new secret ending
[*] Endless mode updates
[*] Quality of life updates
[*] More Achievements
[/list]

So! Let's dive into each one!

[h1]NIGHTMARE MODE[/h1]

For our more eagle-eyed players that love a challenge, we're adding new hard anomalies to the game, just like our original roster, these anomalies can be subtle, spooky or deadly. But be aware, these anomalies are much more difficult. 

Our challenge to you: find them all and unlock a new ending to the game expanding the lore of the Ten Bells even further...
[list]
[*] All new Nightmare Game Mode
[*] 20 Hard Anomalies
[*] New Secret Ending
[*] Nightmare Mode Achievements
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/13910de8f40a3014a407b3e9d46c7400f59e420d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/274f86d515bdff6c96d5b3e1c29c8e81012f041d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/02853a6a6c42aec5f089238c2e5e534a18e84124.jpg[/img]


[h1]QUALITY UPDATES[/h1]

We've had some amazing feedback on how the game looks but also some places we could have improved, so we've done just that.

[list]
[*] The pub landlord has been updated to blink and emote more
[*] Lighting Quality has been increased on characters
[*] The "Endless" Bells, now display numbers for those of you wanting to keep a streak!
[*] Many anomalies have had updates with increased quality in art and animation
[*] An additional [u]13 achievements[/u] for the achievement-hunters
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/7b219de380e23f76790196019a88d3b572a21e19.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/1966fc8959ecde3d0eeec13b4844d9b8d84342d1.jpg[/img]

...Can you reach The 25 Bells?

[h1]EVEN MORE ON THE WAY[/h1]

That's right, we're STILL not done. It's spooky season and we're going to be celebrating in style, so with that we've got even more updates on the way with new game modes and of course; more anomalies. 

Want to keep up to date with the game to give feedback to the devs directly? Join the [url=https://discord.gg/vkQEhWAnz2]discord[/url] and see what other projects we're up to!

notes.title: 1.2.3 Bug Fixes and Anomaly Balancing
notes.notes: We have fixed some minor bugs balanced some anomalies. Some slight adjustments to the pub have also been made.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.2: Korean, SC and Indonesian!
notes.notes:
[h2]A new day, new updates![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/038189e82231695992ded9ddb83a79c14b614a5c.jpg[/img]

Because of the awesome reception in Asia, we've expanded our language options so more people can enjoy the story of Ten Bells! Introducing [b]KOREAN, SIMPLIFIED CHINESE[/b] and [b]INDONESIAN![/b] Spot any translation issues? Let us know in the discussion section of the steam store and we'll get on it! We want to keep improving the game in the run-up to halloween and with your help and feedback, the game is getting better every day. THANK YOU!

Other updates:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ten Bells was respawning
[*] Fixed some Z-fighting artifacts on the walls
[*] Updated some decal graphics
[*] General stability updates
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Lore Update
notes.notes:
We are pleased to release our 1.2.0 ALL THE LORE update. People are really enjoying the game and especially the lore of the game. So we've added even more! After you reach the Ten bells, there are more lore objects to unlock until you reach the Endless Bells. 

- Some anomaly adjustment have also been made as well as some balancing.
- The starting threshold has been adjusted so people spotting anomalies before they leave the lavatory can go back without a worry (that's a sentence i didn't think i'd ever write). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111836/18bb01a5dfa491c3d387e4cddcf4e7427dfaaee8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 1-1-8 Endless Bells Patch
notes.notes: We have amended the game so you can't get the 'Endless Bells' achievement until you reach the Ten Bells. We have also fixed a save data reset bug. We have updated some anomalies too.

notes.title: 1.1.6 Death Patch
notes.notes: We have reworked how the player dies to make it a more stable and spookier experience. We have also fixed a number of small glitches and removed a small number of items from the pub. As well as a few visual updates. An anomaly that was trapping the player has been fixed too.
